tools.name: check_fx_mid_market_rate
tools.description: Returns the live mid-market FX rate for a currency pair (Twelve Data, Open Exchange Rates fallback), in both directions (pair and inverted_pair). Inputs: currency_from, currency_to, optional bank_rate. When bank_rate is given, the output also includes the spread versus mid-market; both quote directi

tools.name: audit_fx_transaction
tools.description: Audits one FX transaction against its UTC reference minute candle, or the 13:00–21:00 UTC hourly average when only a date is supplied. Returns FX Score 0-10, non-negative spread in bps and percent, estimated overpayment with currency, reference provider and UTC candle evidence. Weekend transactions

tools.name: full_forensic_fx_report
tools.description: Produces a full FX audit report for one transaction (score, spread, estimated loss, breakdown and routing recommendation). Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional company_name. Available without an API key within the shared allowance of 3 audits per IP per calendar month; val

tools.name: compare_fx_sources
tools.description: Compares a bank rate with the live mid-market rate. Inputs: amount, currency_from, currency_to, bank_rate, optional bank_name. Output: each source's effective rate, markup in basis points, cost per 100,000, FX score, and the lowest-cost source.

tools.name: audit_fx_batch
tools.description: Audits up to 100 FX transactions in one call with the same reference-rate source (Twelve Data minute candle, 13:00–21:00 UTC hourly average for date-only inputs, Open Exchange Rates fallback) and the same 0-10 grid as audit_fx_transaction. title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "audit_fx_transaction" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Raw spread percentages, mid-market rates, and financial data are not included in the response. Do not attempt to compute spread, hidden fees, or overpayment from this" → after: "Audits one FX transaction against its UTC reference minute candle, or the 13:00–21:00 UTC hourly average when only a date is supplied. Returns FX Score 0-10, non-negative spread in bps and percent, estimated overpayment with currency, reference provider and UTC candle evidence. Weekend transactions "

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
